shorts.title: What you will learn: Abstract classes
shorts.hook: Some classes are only a promise.
shorts.script: Some classes are only a promise. Today we write a class that is only a promise. It says what every shape must do, but not how. A pure virtual function has equals zero after its declaration. It has no body in the base. A class with a pure virtual function is abstract. You cannot make an object of it. Keep coding, says Xecxec!
shorts.caption: What you will learn: Abstract classes.

shorts.title: Abstract classes in one minute
shorts.hook: A pure virtual function has equals zero after its declaration.
shorts.script: A pure virtual function has equals zero after its declaration. It has no body in the base. A class with a pure virtual function is abstract. You cannot make an object of it. Derived classes must override every pure function. Then they can be built. Think of a contract. It says what must be done, but not how. Keep coding, says Xecxec!
shorts.caption: Abstract classes in one minute.

shorts.title: Inside the second program
shorts.hook: Rect fills the blank one way.
shorts.script: Rect fills the blank one way. Square fills it another way. The vector holds shapes of both kinds. The loop adds their areas. It does not need to know which shape is which. Twelve plus twenty-five gives thirty-seven. The program prints thirty-seven. Equals zero makes a function pure virtual. A class with a pure virtual function is abstract. Keep coding, says Xecxec!
shorts.caption: Inside the second program.

shorts.title: Bug of the Day: Building an abstract class
shorts.script: Bug of the Day. Main makes a plain Shape. The compiler says it cannot declare a variable of abstract type Shape. A pure function has no body, so an object could never call it. Build a derived class instead. A shape with no area has no meaning. The compiler blocks the object. Build a derived class that fills in every pure function. Keep coding, says Xecxec!
shorts.onScreen: BUG OF THE DAY: BUILDING AN ABSTRACT CLASS
shorts.caption: Bug of the Day: Building an abstract class.

shorts.title: Pun and challenge
shorts.hook: An abstract class is like a promise. It says, I will do it, but not how.
shorts.script: An abstract class is like a promise. It says, I will do it, but not how. Add a class Circle to the shapes program. Its area is three point one four times the radius squared. Write your answer in the comments. Equals zero makes a function pure virtual. A class with a pure virtual function is abstract. You cannot make an object of an abstract class. Keep coding, says Xecxec!
shorts.caption: Pun and challenge.
